title: Add Kokoro Roto — Anime Art Generator to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Kokoro Roto — Anime Art Generator](https://geneberna.github.io/kokoro-roto-anime) to image
- A free, no-signup web app to generate anime-style art with AI. Type an idea, pick a mood (dramatic, sad, epic, portrait), choose a format, and instantly create anime characters and scenes. Powered by 

Fixes #13549

gist.headline: Anime blooms in the hive
gist.blurb: Kokoro Roto has landed in the image garden: a free, no-signup place to turn an idea and a mood into anime scenes. Pick dramatic, sad, epic, or portrait; the pixels handle the melodrama.
gist.summary: Added Kokoro Roto — Anime Art Generator to the image app directory, offering free no-signup AI anime generation with mood presets and format choices.
gist.impact: People browsing image apps can now find Kokoro Roto and quickly create anime characters or scenes from a prompt, mood, and chosen format.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Kokoro Roto as a cozy anime-art studio inside the Pollinations garden: Polli, wearing a tiny painter's beret, helps a retro easel-monitor display a soft anime character portrait. Use floating mood cards labeled DRAMATIC, SAD, EPIC, and PORTRAIT, with flowers and code-plants growing around the workspace to represent an accessible community image app.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny painter's beret, hovering beside a retro easel-monitor that displays a gentle anime character portrait; pastel mood cards read “DRAMATIC,” “SAD,” “EPIC,” and “PORTRAIT,” surrounded by blooming code-plants and flowers. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft lime green (#ecf874) and pastel gradient background, chunky retro sprites, warm lighting, lo-fi vibes like Stardew Valley or A Short Hike, nostalgic but beautiful.
